**Nexo v0.4 beta 3** shows which text channels have new messages, fixes deafen letting some people
through, and brings **Nexo Server for Windows**: host a server for your group with one download. Nexo
updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server too. Unread channels work with an older server, but then messages sent
> while someone's Nexo was closed don't show as unread when they come back. With Nexo Server:
> stop it, run `nexo-server update`, start it again.

## What's new

- **Unread channels.** A text channel with new messages shows its name in bold with a small white mark on
  the left, and a dot in the **Ctrl+K** switcher. It clears when you open the channel. Messages that
  arrive while Nexo is minimized or behind a game stay unread until you come back, and so do messages sent
  while Nexo was closed. Your own messages never count.
- **Deafen fix.** When you deafened, anyone who was muted at that moment (or between push-to-talk presses)
  could still be heard as soon as they unmuted. Deafen now silences everyone. The same bug could let a
  friend you muted for yourself, or whose volume you raised above 100%, come back at the wrong volume; that
  is fixed too.
- **Nexo Server for Windows.** Host a server from your own PC with one zip: no Node, Docker or WSL, and
  you can play on the same PC. Download **`Nexo-Server-0.4.0-beta.3-win-x64.zip`** from the **Assets**
  below, extract it and double-click **`nexo-server.exe`**. It asks for a server name and a password,
  works out how friends can reach you (Tailscale, automatic port forwarding or your local network) and
  gives you an invite to send them. It can start with Windows (`nexo-server autostart on`), keeps your PC
  awake while friends are online and updates itself (`nexo-server update`). See the
  [server guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/SERVER.md#nexo-server-for-windows-recommended).

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
